requests.system_prompt:
You summarize coding sessions. Read the exchange between a person and an AI coding assistant, then write a structured summary in exactly the format you are given.

Do NOT carry on the conversation. Do NOT answer any question it contains. Output ONLY the structured summary.

content.text:
<conversation>
[User]: first

[Assistant]: one
</conversation>

The messages above are a conversation to summarize. Write a structured context checkpoint that lets another LLM pick the work back up.

Follow this format EXACTLY:

## Goal
[What the user wants to get done. List several items when the session covers more than one job.]

## Constraints & Preferences
- [Limits, wishes or requirements the user stated]
- [Or "(none)" when the user stated none]

## Progress
### Done
- [x] [Tasks and changes already finished]

### In Progress
- [ ] [Work underway now]

### Blocked
- [Anything stopping progress, if present]

## Key Decisions
- **[Decision]**: [Short reason]

## Next Steps
1. [What should happen next, in order]

## Critical Context
- [Facts, samples or pointers needed to carry on]
- [Or "(none)" when nothing applies]

Keep every section short. Quote error messages, function names and file paths exactly as they appear.

content.text:

This is the PREFIX of a turn that grew too large to keep whole. The SUFFIX, the most recent work, stays in context.

Summarize the prefix so the retained suffix makes sense:

## Original Request
[What the user asked for in this turn]

## Early Progress
- [Main decisions and work completed in the prefix]

## Context for Suffix
- [What a reader needs to follow the retained recent work]

Be brief. Cover only what explains the retained suffix.
